decision.reason: NTT West 13 October primary statement launches Ibaraki school pilot of private tsuzumi 2 LLM with privacy and efficacy testing; an evidence-led human pilot-review workflow exists.

opportunities.idea_name: Private School AI Pilot Evidence Dashboard
opportunities.core_job: Evaluate school document-assistant pilots against access control, teacher usefulness, task time and privacy acceptance metrics
opportunities.target_customer: Japanese municipal school boards and K-12 pilot administrators
opportunities.product_mechanism: Pilot source document types, role permission, trial task duration, participant feedback and test evidence, signoff CSV, deterministic before-after comparison; no runtime LLM dependency
opportunities.why_now: NTT West/Ibaraki City's 13 October primary announcement launches a private tsuzumi 2 school administrative AI pilot through March 2027 with usefulness, access-control and time-savings evaluations.
opportunities.before_state: Private LLM pilot evaluation happens in fragmented staff feedback and project folders.
opportunities.after_state: Traceable school AI pilot evaluation and readiness approval report.
